BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to replacement of license plates; and amending RCW46.16.233.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.233 and 2000 c 37 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except for those license plates issued under RCW 46.16.305(1)before January 1, 1987, under RCW 46.16.305(3), and to commercialvehicles with a gross weight in excess of twentysix thousand pounds,effective with vehicle registrations due or to become due on January 1,2001, all vehicle license plates must be issued on a standardbackground, as designated by the department. ((Additionally,)) (2) To ensure maximum legibility and reflectivity, the departmentshall periodically provide for the replacement of license plates asspecified by this section, except for commercial vehicles with a grossweight in excess of twentysix thousand pounds. ((Frequency ofreplacement shall)) The functional lifetime of the license plate mustbe established in accordance with empirical studies documenting thelongevity of the reflective materials used to make license plates. p. 1 HB 1224 (3) The department may, upon the transfer of a vehicle, require thenew owner to replace the license plates at the same time the new ownerregisters the vehicle if the vehicle's existing license plates haveexceeded their functional lifetime. The department may replace licenseplates at other times upon request of the current owner if thefunctional lifetime of the plates has been exceeded. The departmentshall not require replacement of license plates at other times.
